newsitem.title: CANADA: Wascana jumps to new high on bid talk.
newsitem.headline: Wascana jumps to new high on bid talk.

text.p: Shares of Wascana Energy Inc hit an all-time high and Talisman Energy Inc slid further on Thursday as investors appeared to continue betting a higher offer for Wascana was in the works.

Wascana, which this week fueled speculation of a richer bid by unveiling vastly improved oil and gas reserve data and telling shareholders that data room activity was brisk, jumped 0.30 to 19.45 in busy trade.
Talisman, meanwhile, dropped 0.50 to trade at 43.70, its lowest level since the company launched its C$1.7 billion cash and stock offer for Wascana in early February.
Talisman has offered C$18.50 cash or 0.41 of a Talisman share for each Wascana share.
However, with the gap between Wascana's share price and and Talisman's share-swap value opening to its widest yet, market speculation on a higher bid surfacing was hot, traders said.
"The arbs right now are driving it higher in anticipation of either a higher Talisman bid or someone else coming in," one trader said.
Talisman's offer expires on March 24. Wascana's bnoard this week urged shareholders to reject the bid.
